curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Cut off from the only life they know, how can a fragile cluster of outdated domestic gadgets survive the open world to find their master?
curatedMovie.description: Left stranded when their family sells their summer home, a resilient group of dated household appliances sets out on an improbable journey across the countryside to track down their beloved eight-year-old owner.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: An exciting, warmhearted animated adventure with steady pacing, moderate emotional stakes, and accessible family appeal.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Jerry Rees directs a delightfully eccentric animated fantasy that pairs an imaginative premise with genuine warmth, turning household objects into spirited adventurers.
